entries.title: The Blue Door
entries.memo: keyed entry — fires when a key appears in recent chat
entries.content: The Blue Door Tavern sits where three roads meet. Its lantern never goes out, and the keeper remembers every name that ever walked in.

entries.content: The King's Road runs past the tavern north to the capital. Toll collectors wear grey and ask no questions twice.
